figurative_meaning_en: Pushing and shoving due to the continuous flow of people coming and going
example_sentences_in_bangla: ট্রেন স্টেশনে ঠেলাঠেলির মধ্যে দিয়ে যেতে হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: There's pushing and shoving in the market due to the crowd.
